full_judgment: 2. Briefly stated, the facts for disposal of the this Rule are, that the plaintiff (petitioner) filed OC Suit No. 323 of 1974 against the defendant opposite party Nos. 1-4 for a declaration of title and recovery of khas possession after evicting them from the suit land. The said suit was dismissed on 27-8-76 and the plaintiff took an appeal. The appellate Court remanded the case to the trial Court for fresh trial after remand, the suit was decreed and execution was started and the plaintiff petitioner got possession by executing the decree. The defendants opposite parties thereafter filed an application under Order 9 rule 13 of the Code of Civil Procedure read with section 151 of the Code for setting aside the decree on the ground that the decres was obtained by practising fraud.
